title: Compile visible target hitting into joint microscopic preparation only with a real conditional reset
statement: An actual label-preserving instrument must restore the baseline conditional hidden law UNIFORMLY and jointly with its emitted records. Then target-label hitting composes into the claimed complete preparation, including calibration-correlated starts. Invariance, marginal mixing or an unobserved state-only TV bound does not supply that instrument.
